name: 陳岡伯
objective: In order to cultivate the students’ comprehensive capabilities to use English, especially the listening comprehension and oral expression ability, different multimedia materials in popular culture, including movies, songs, TV series, and animations, are used to help students understand when and how to use language appropriately in various situations. Different activities (listening practice, role-play, group discussion, and oral presentation) are designed to facilitate students’ English learning.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction

Unit 1: Humanities and life

Week 2-3: The Dead Poet Society

Unit 2: Moral dilemma

Week 4-5: Scent of a Woman

Unit 3: Individuality and collectivity

Week 6-7: A Few Good Men

Unit 4: Order and chaos

Week 8-9: The Dark Knight

Unit 5: Religion and God

Week 10-11: The Devil's Advocate

Unit 6: Gender fluidity & political correctness

Week 12-13: "Stunning and Beautiful" & "Tweek & Craig" from South Park

Unit 7: Cultural exchanges

Week 14-15: Pocahontas 

Week 16-17: Group presentations

Week 18: Final exam
scorePolicy:
Attendance and participation: 30%
Joint exam: 20%
Group presentation: 30%
Final exam: 20%
materials: All materials will be provided by the instructor.
延伸教學與資源: ● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
